title: a16z creates a $1.1B Machine Age fund focusing on hardware to "open the throttle and accelerate the physical buildout of AI" (Sean O'Kane/TechCrunch)
summary: Sean O'Kane / TechCrunch: a16z creates a $1.1B Machine Age fund focusing on hardware to “open the throttle and accelerate the physical buildout of AI” — Andreessen Horowitz has launched a new “Machine Age” fund with $1.1 billion raised. The firm's aim with the new fund is to “open the throttle and accelerate the physical buildout of AI.”
contentText:
Sean O'Kane / TechCrunch :

a16z creates a $1.1B Machine Age fund focusing on hardware to “open the throttle and accelerate the physical buildout of AI”   —  Andreessen Horowitz has launched a new “Machine Age” fund with $1.1 billion raised.  The firm's aim with the new fund is to “open the throttle and accelerate the physical buildout of AI.”
